purpose: Prevent favorable-source selection, hidden averaging, or silent promotion when regulatory evidence sources disagree.

cases.trigger: Route A submitted-peak network and Route B fragment-reconstructed network fail the frozen reconciliation rule
cases.action: Do not select the route that agrees with protected validation. Either qualify only the stable program/module intersection under the frozen rule, or block the program.

cases.trigger: Stage 4 is positive but a prospectively eligible external replication source is negative/incompatible
cases.action: Preserve both results. Do not label universal biology. Apply the predeclared scope/disagreement rule and narrow or block teacher eligibility.

cases.trigger: Stage 4 is interpretable-null but external evidence is positive
cases.action: Do not convert Stage 4 null into positive support. Preserve source-specific result and investigate population/measurement scope only under a new prospective hypothesis.

cases.trigger: Frozen regulatory program predicts a perturbational consequence but qualified perturbation contradicts it
cases.action: Do not threshold-tune the network. Report contradiction and retire/narrow that causal interpretation.

cases.trigger: Spatial panel lacks sufficient program genes
cases.action: Classify as structurally unmeasured; not negative biology.

cases.trigger: A source does not measure required program features
cases.action: Record missing structural support; never numeric zero.

global_rules: Never average conflicting source-specific statistics merely to obtain one summary score.
Never choose the source with the most favorable outcome after inspection.
Never use cell count to overrule donor-level disagreement.
Every disagreement outcome preserves exact source identities, populations, feature support and exposure states.
A new reconciliation method after protected outcomes are seen creates a new prospective version and cannot retroactively rescue the old test.
